verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing/entitlements SaaS platform, not an AI agent — the story asks whether the product can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools, which only applies to agentic products. Evidence shows the opposite direction: Autumn ships an MCP *server* so other AI assistants can call Autumn's own billing tools (autumn-docs-7, autumn-probe-3), which does not make this client-side axis applicable.
